items.title: Tablet zoom and new Rick's tabs tomorrow
items.body:
Tablet zoom goes live tomorrow, November 22! Find it under Display in Settings and pick 100%, 115% or 125%. 100% keeps the same view you have now, and the tablet remembers your choice.

Rick's wheel collections are also getting their own colors and bigger emblems. The pink rose and Revenant mask now sit to the right of their collection names.

Check out yesterday's update, and I'll be adding more this weekend! Leave an endorsement on Nexus if you enjoy it!

items.title: Demon Time is here
items.body: The Demon Line is now at Rick's, starting with the Revenant III, black swept blades, a candy red dish and red LEDs with a demon mask that light up with your running lights and headlights. Coming soon, options to keep the lights on or turn them on whenever you want, a Rick's refresh with its own color for each line, more rims, new items like a tool tray that organizes for you, more Repair Network updates, more languages and new settings like zoom. Thanks to everyone who downloaded this weekend, there's a lot more fun on the way. - PPD MODS

items.title: Pink Rose Line and bigger wheels at Rick's
items.body: Rick's now has the Pink Rose Line, 5 pink rims that stay for good, plus 18, 19 and 20 inch sizes for every rim so trucks finally look right. There are new tires too, including a 33 inch off-road tire for 17 to 20 inch rims, and normal profile is now the default. Inflate your tires after mounting them, the tire machine leaves them flat.

items.title: Rick's Truck & Tires is now live
items.body: Rick's Truck & Tires app is now live, a family-owned wheel and tire shop on your tablet where you can pick from 15 rim designs and 5 monthly exclusives, choose your colors, preview them on your car and get it all delivered to your garage desk. The Supply app also has a new Rim & Tire Cart, made to move your rims and tires effortlessly. I will be adding many more, leave ideas on discord. - Enjoy

items.title: GarageLink 0.9.6.1 - Auction Update is here!
items.body: GarageLink 0.9.6.1 Auction Update is here! Bid on everything from total losses and barn finds to clean trade-ins and hidden gems. Outbid Rhett and Dee, or they might make you pay for it! Inspect before you bid, or try buying a car from the person who beat you. Rick's Truck & Tires delivers right to your garage, with delivery tracking and paperwork. Track your flip profits too, sell your projects on SellMe for accurate profit. Plus cleaner screens, centered text and other bug and QOL fixes. Check the changelog for more. I'll keep you posted on more updates. Thanks for the support! -PPD Mods

items.title: Repair Network Update Part 1 is here!
items.body: Repair Network Update Part 1 is out! This is part 1 of 2, part 2 coming soon it will finish off any QOL fixes from part 1 and add alot more. The Claims screen has been redesigned, and the whole look and feel is more organized. Repair types are now in tabs, including Collision with both minor and major crash repairs, created from scratch. Eight new crash profiles add more variety to the damage and parts you'll be fixing, with heavy accidents causing damage behind the panels too. Repair points helps you find and work the screws, bolts and welds on the part you're looking at,

items.title: Repair Network Update Part 1 continued
items.body: you'll find it in the repair section once you've started repairing a car from Repair Network. You can also order one part, a few parts or the whole cart. Added the Tripod Work Light to PPD Supply, and added the GarageLink Charging Stand to PPD Supply! Plus cleaner claim cards, more maintenance jobs, fixes for crash cars disappearing or arriving without damage, and other minor bug fixes and QOL improvements. SellMe down payments now show in loan history, and Sold signs can be printed once a sale is agreed. Thanks for the support! -PPD Mods.

items.title: GarageLink 0.9.5 - Financing and the UK update PART 1
items.body: Financing is here. Sell cars on payments and carry the loan yourself, or send buyers to three partner lenders. Buyers apply for credit, you pull their report, you decide their downpayment, terms and rates, plus more.. Work every deal on the new negotiation tab with cosigners, split down payments, extras, final offers and more to explore. Late payers go to Collections, from reminders to repo and auction. The DMV goes international too, play in the UK with UK plates, a GB licence, V5C log books, vehicle tax and the MOT. The UK Update is part 1, it is still recommended to play using USA and a state. Thanks for the support! -PPD mods

items.title: 0.9.4: Printing fixes and a more reliable tablet.
items.body: This update fixes Print Studio, Vehicle Studio and document printing on some setups, and Reissue papers works every time again. Paperwork that wouldn't open or print now does. We've also added protections so the tablet and its apps keep running smoothly across many different setups and alongside other mods, plus plenty of smaller bug fixes. Thanks for the support!

items.title: GarageLink 0.9.2 - Repair Network
items.body: Repair Network is here. Take insurance repair jobs built around the game's native jobs, inspect customer cars through your tablet, submit estimates for approval and complete the repairs. Arrange a courtesy car through RentMe or use a simulated partner rental. Finish each job with a final inspection, signed release and printable paperwork. Includes detailed claim files, customer reviews, expanded invoices and a Refresh Claims button to bring in new work. Every document printable. Thank you again for downloading! -PPD mods

items.title: GarageLink 0.9.1
items.body: Printed signs and papers now stick to your cars, and the DEALER plate sits on the rear bracket. SellMe has a full-size website you can preview on a computer or a phone, a new showroom home page, far more detailed sale papers, and buyers who don't repeat themselves.

items.title: GarageLink is live!
items.body: GarageLink is now available on Nexus Mods. Thanks for downloading and trying it!

items.title: Welcome to GarageLink
items.body: Your PPD Instruments tablet for the garage. Title and register your cars in the DMV, insure them with Fender & Bender, and rent them out on RentMe or sell them on SellMe. PPD Supply delivers printers, document folders and flood lights to your desk. Tap ? on any screen for a quick guide.
